tools.name: mcg_catalog
tools.description: Enabled simulation kinds (each with example mcg_quote arguments that price, a note naming what must exist first, or both; traced says whether the kind's default lineage has a single public OpenMaterials node pin, traced_note why or why not; research coordinators instead expose record_contract descri

tools.name: mcg_rates
tools.description: The public rate card: token_usd, overheads, rate_card_version. FREE, no arguments; also a connectivity check.

tools.name: mcg_quote
tools.description: Price a simulation. FREE: no hardware starts. Returns quote_id, quote_hash, tokens, rate_card_version, wall_s, expires_at, resource_class, resource_label and sku (the GPU class the quote is bound to, its name, and the offer SKU it priced; null when none was chosen), resource_options (one row per cla

tools.name: mcg_clusters
tools.description: Connected clusters: id, name, preset (hive or auto), status (pending until the agent's first sync; connected; stale: the agent stopped syncing; revoked; scheduler_down: the agent syncs but cannot reach the scheduler, nothing is offered; agent_outdated: an auto cluster's agent sends no inventory; sna

tools.name: mcg_stage
tools.description: Create a DRAFT simulation whose input files are uploaded before pricing. FREE. Takes the same kind, spec, study, material and conditions as mcg_quote plus inputs: one entry per file the run needs, each with a name and, for small text files, the text inline (staged immediately). Entries without text

tools.name: mcg_run
tools.description: Launch the quoted simulation. SPENDS TOKENS: provisions hardware and bills the account. Requires the quote_id and quote_hash from mcg_quote (a stale hash or an expired quote REJECTS: re-quote and retry) and a client-generated idempotency_key (replaying it returns the existing run instead of launchin

tools.name: mcg_list_runs
tools.description: List runs, newest first: every run of this key's owner, or one quote's runs when quote_id is given. Each row carries state, spend_tokens, created_by_key_name (null when launched in the browser), study, headline (the AI brief's first line) and app_url. Returns runs.

tools.name: mcg_get_study
tools.description: Fetch a study (the project a quote's `study` named) with its member simulations and their latest runs. Pass study_id or the exact name. Returns study, members (each with app_url) and app_url.

tools.name: mcg_get_run
tools.description: Fetch a run's state, event timeline and LLM spend. The payload leads with a derived summary (state, current_stage, billing {quoted_tokens, charged_tokens, hold, policy}, fault, refusal, next, last event, campaign) for cheap polling, then app_url (the run page, for the human), study and headline. eve

tools.name: mcg_cancel_run
tools.description: Cancel a run from any non-terminal state before collecting (a collecting run's outputs are delivered and charged: 409). The cancel request is recorded immediately and returns run_id and cancel_requested true (and a note, for a running campaign); the platform kills the machine and terminalizes the ru

tools.name: mcg_fetch_artifacts
tools.description: List a run's collected artifacts as a typed manifest: artifacts, a list of path, bytes, stage and sha256 per file, plus removed on a file the retention sweep deleted (its bytes are gone; do not fetch it) and attribution on a third-party model's file (its license notice; keep it with any copy); trunc

tools.name: mcg_get_artifact
tools.description: Fetch one artifact file's TEXT content, up to max_bytes (default 65536), with an explicit truncation note. Binary content REJECTS with unsupported_content; fetch binaries from the run's public page. A third-party model's file returns its full license notice first, as an [attribution] text item.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "mcg_quote" is 2778 chars, far longer than this server's median (490). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mcg_quote · Private data: mcg_catalog, mcg_quote, mcg_stage, mcg_run, mcg_get_run, mcg_cancel_run, mcg_fetch_artifacts, mcg_get_artifact · Public sink: mcg_clusters, mcg_stage · Destructive: mcg_catalog, mcg_quote, mcg_clusters, mcg_stage, mcg_run, mcg_list_runs, mcg_get_run, mcg_cancel_run, mcg_fetch_artifacts, mcg_get_artifact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mcg_quote · Private data: mcg_catalog, mcg_quote, mcg_stage, mcg_run, mcg_get_run, mcg_cancel_run, mcg_fetch_artifacts, mcg_get_artifact · Public sink: mcg_clusters, mcg_stage · Destructive: mcg_catalog, mcg_quote, mcg_clusters, mcg_stage, mcg_run, mcg_list_runs, mcg_get_run, mcg_cancel_run, mcg_fetch_artifacts, mcg_get_artifact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
